description: This file provides utility functions for making API GET requests in a web application. It handles URL construction, authentication headers, organization ID appending, and response processing. The main exported function is `apiGet`, which simplifies fetching data from the backend API with proper URL handling and error management.

methods.name: isAbsoluteUrl(url)
methods.description: Checks if a given URL is absolute (starts with http:// or https://).

methods.name: getBaseApiUrl()
methods.description: Determines the base URL for API requests, using window location, environment variable, or defaulting to '/api'.

methods.name: joinUrl(base, path)
methods.description: Joins a base URL with a relative or absolute path, correctly handling cases with '/api' prefix.

methods.name: ensureOrgIdInUrl(url, explicitOrgId)
methods.description: Appends organization_id parameter to the URL if available and not already present.

methods.name: apiGet(pathOrUrl, options = {})
methods.description: Main exported function that performs an HTTP GET request with URL resolution, headers, organization ID, and response handling.
